subject: eng
title: Present Continuous: I am reading now. am / is / are + -ing
goal: Ти вивчиш новий час — Present Continuous, щоб розповідати, що відбувається зараз: I am reading now.

theory.text: Досі ти розповідав, що робиш ЗАЗВИЧАЙ (Present Simple: I play football on Mondays). Сьогодні навчишся розповідати, що відбувається ЗАРАЗ, цієї миті — це новий час, Present Continuous.

items.ex: She is cooking at the moment.
They are playing football right now.

theory.title: am / is / are + -ing
theory.text: Present Continuous: **am/is/are + дієслово-ing**. **I am reading** now. (Я зараз читаю.) **She is cooking** dinner at the moment. **They are playing** football right now. Заперечення: am/is/are + **not**: She **isn't cooking** now. Питання: **Is she cooking?** — Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.

lines.text: Hi, Sam! What are you doing now?
Hi, Kate! I am doing my homework at the moment.
Oh! Is Andriy doing his homework too?
No, he isn't. He is playing football in the garden right now.
And what is your mum doing?
She is cooking dinner. Look, it smells great!

theory.text: Не плутай Present Simple (I play football every day — зазвичай) і Present Continuous (I am playing football now — саме зараз). Слова-підказки для Present Continuous: now, at the moment, right now, Look!

exercises.q: Встав am, is або are + дієслово-ing.
exercises.text: I {am reading} a book now. She {is cooking} dinner at the moment. They {are playing} football right now.
exercises.hint: I → am; he/she/it → is; you/we/they → are.

exercises.explain: Present Continuous = am/is/are + -ing, а слово now вказує на дію зараз.

exercises.q: Прочитай діалог ще раз. Так чи ні?

items.text: Sam is doing his homework at the moment.
Andriy is doing his homework too.
Andriy is playing football in the garden.

exercises.text: I am reading now. She is cooking dinner at the moment. They are playing football.

homework.text: He {is writing} a letter now. We {are watching} a film at the moment.

homework.explain: sit — короткий голосний + приголосна, тому подвоюємо: sitting.

homework.q: Напиши 4-5 речень про те, що зараз роблять члени твоєї родини (Present Continuous: am/is/are + -ing).
homework.sample: I am doing my homework now. My mum is cooking dinner at the moment. My dad is reading a newspaper. My sister is watching a film. My dog is sleeping.

homework.text: I am doing my homework now. My mum is cooking dinner. We are having a good day.

reflection: Яка різниця між I play football (зазвичай) і I am playing football (зараз)?
